description: Retrieve metadata for one exact credential/BU/query key using reviewed Windows mcdev 10.1.0; never execute or activate SQL. Performs fresh local preparation; no preview token or custom approval form is required. Host tool approval remains host-controlled. Caller must maintain quiescent project/path access from preparation through process/artifact settlement; the server does not enforce external exclusion. Native mcdev may create/overwrite or delete the exact JSON/SQL pair, read parent/shared dependencies and privately refresh/persist authentication/session state. No authentication/session content inspection or raw native output is returned. Request cancellation is supervised; partial effects and unknown termination are possible. Unknown termination blocks further project runs pending operator reconciliation; restarting is not proof of reconciliation. No automatic retry. Zero exit and local artifacts never prove remote completeness.
